evidence.title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?

summary: Recent research examines the capability of large generative models to serve as accurate simulators of real-world environments, highlighting both promising advances and fundamental limitations. The analysis underscores the need for improved grounding, causal reasoning, and evaluation metrics before world models can reliably replace traditional simulators.
title: How Close Are AI World Models to True Simulators?
